name: Excava, the Risen Past

abilities.text: Whenever ~ attacks, return up to one target artifact, creature, or non-Aura enchantment card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. It's a 1/1 Spirit creature with flying in addition to its other types.

notes: The documented idiom for a targeted graveyard return (VOCABULARY.md §8: 'Return up to N target <filter> cards from your graveyard to the battlefield' -> return-from-graveyard with count and optional). return-from-graveyard binds what it returned, so the counters and the animate that follow are about that card; the engine adds a move's withCounters after enterBattlefield too (game.ts opMove), so the two spellings are behaviourally identical here. animate UNIONS types and subtypes onto the printed ones (characteristics.ts types()/subtypes()), which is exactly 'in addition to its other types'. notSubtypes ['Aura'] is very slightly wider than the printed 'non-Aura enchantment'.
